INSERT INTO analytics.refresh_requests (id, tenant_id, kind, scope_key, causes, requested_at, not_before, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, 'PENDING') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, kind, scope_key) WHERE status = 'PENDING' DO UPDATE SET causes = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(analytics.refresh_requests.causes) < 20 THEN analytics.refresh_requests.causes || EXCLUDED.causes ELSE analytics.refresh_requests.causes END, not_before = LEAST(analytics.refresh_requests.not_before, EXCLUDED.not_before) RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS created

SELECT 1 AS ok FROM people.persons p JOIN people.guardians g ON g.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND g.person_id = p.id JOIN people.student_guardians sg ON sg.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND sg.guardian_id = g.id JOIN people.relationship_types rt ON rt.tenant_id = sg.tenant_id AND rt.code = sg.relationship_code WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.identity_id = $2 AND sg.student_id = $3 AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sg.valid_to IS NULL AND sg.portal_access AND rt.kind = 'GUARDIAN' LIMIT 1
